CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Family Unity? (1 mark)
   A. Say Family Unity has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Family Unity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Family Unity.
   D. Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of My purpose Talents and abilities? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My purpose Talents and abilities.
   B. Say My purpose Talents and abilities has no place in daily life.
   C. Use My purpose Talents and abilities to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of My purpose Talents and abilities with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

4. Which response best shows understanding of King Solomon the wise ruler? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing King Solomon the wise ruler.
   B. Apply the teaching of King Solomon the wise ruler with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use King Solomon the wise ruler to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say King Solomon the wise ruler has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible as a Guide? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible as a Guide.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Bible as a Guide with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Bible as a Guide to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Bible as a Guide has no place in daily life.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

7. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Birth of Moses has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Birth of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth of Moses.
   D. Use The Birth of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Fall of Man.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Fall of Man has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.
   B. Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

12. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.
   C. Say Work has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Social Media and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain My purpose Talents and abilities and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Work and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Fall of Man and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
